Tiny C Compiler 0.9.27 — Fabrice Bellard and contributors; LGPL-2.1-or-later.
Original compiler, DLL, headers and libraries are unmodified. MinGW header notices remain in their original files.
This is a legacy compatibility fixture, not a current production-toolchain recommendation.
Project: https://bellard.org/tcc/
Complete corresponding source is bundled in Aster.html; download it using Win32 Lab > TinyCC source.
It is also available at third-party/tinycc/tcc-0.9.27.tar.bz2 in the repository/hosted distribution.
Original source: https://download-mirror.savannah.gnu.org/releases/tinycc/tcc-0.9.27.tar.bz2
